Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Body:
EPUBMaker does not require user accounts and does not collect personal information for authentication.

We may collect: (a) Usage data: file metadata (filename, size) processed during conversion — files are not stored server-side after conversion; (b) IP addresses for rate limiting and abuse prevention; (c) Error reports: anonymized diagnostic data sent to Sentry for debugging; (d) Analytics: aggregated, non-identifying site usage data via Vercel Analytics.
Privacy.section2Body: EPUBMaker stores your recent conversion history and settings locally in your browser using localStorage and IndexedDB. This data never leaves your device and is not transmitted to our servers. You can clear this data at any time by clearing your browser storage.
Privacy.section3Body: Files you upload for conversion are processed in memory on our servers and returned to you as EPUB downloads. We do not store, retain, or analyze your uploaded documents after conversion is complete.
Privacy.section4Body: We use: Sentry for error monitoring (anonymized data only); Vercel Analytics for aggregate traffic metrics; Google AdSense for advertising (Google's privacy policy applies to ad personalization). We do not sell or share your personal information with any third party.
Privacy.section5Body: EPUBMaker previously operated as a subscription service with user accounts. All previously collected account data (email addresses, conversion history, subscription records) will be permanently deleted from our systems by 2026-08-01. If you had an account, no further action is required on your part.
Privacy.section6Body: For privacy-related questions, contact us via the contact method provided on epubmaker.org.

Refund.title: Refund Policy
Refund.section1Body: EPUBMaker is now a completely free service. There are no subscriptions, plans, or payments of any kind. No refund policy is applicable.
Refund.section2Body: If you were a paid subscriber during the previous subscription period and believe you are owed a refund, please contact us with your order details. We will review requests on a case-by-case basis.
Refund.section3Body: Contact us via the email address on epubmaker.org for any billing questions related to the previous paid service.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything about EPUBMaker and digital publishing.
FAQ.q1: What file formats can I upload?
FAQ.a1: EPUBMaker supports DOCX (Word) and TXT files. All are converted to standard EPUB 3 or EPUB 2.
FAQ.q2: Do I need an account to convert files?
FAQ.a2: No. EPUBMaker is completely free with no account required. Just upload your file and convert.
FAQ.q3: Is there a file size limit?
FAQ.a3: Files must be 50 MB or smaller. Cover images must be 10 MB or smaller. Most manuscripts are well within these limits.
FAQ.q4: Which EPUB version should I choose?
FAQ.a4: EPUB 3 is recommended — it supports rich media, better typography, and modern reading apps. Use EPUB 2 only for older devices.
FAQ.q5: Why doesn't my table of contents appear?
FAQ.a5: For DOCX files, the TOC is generated from Heading styles. Make sure your document uses Word's built-in heading styles, not manually bolded text.
FAQ.q6: What cover image dimensions work best?
FAQ.a6: Amazon Kindle recommends 2,560 x 1,600 px. Apple Books recommends 1,400 x 2,100 px. A safe universal size is 1,600 x 2,400 px.
FAQ.q7: Can I edit the table of contents after conversion?
FAQ.a7: Yes. After conversion, use the built-in TOC Editor to reorder, rename, indent, or delete chapters before downloading.
FAQ.a8: Yes. EPUBMaker is a completely free tool with no conversion limits, supported by non-intrusive advertising.

faq.q1: Do I need to log in to use EPUBMaker?
faq.a1: No. The login system has been removed. Just visit epubmaker.org and start converting files immediately.
faq.q2: Where is my conversion history saved?
faq.a2: Your recent conversion history and settings are saved in your browser's local storage (IndexedDB). This data stays on your device only.
faq.q3: What happened to my previous account data?
faq.a3: All previous account data will be permanently and securely deleted from our servers by August 1, 2026.
faq.q4: Is there a limit on how many files I can convert?
faq.a4: No. There are no daily limits, monthly limits, or conversion caps. Convert as many files as you need.
